native_original_tests_cumulative.scope: Focused original groups; full upstream suite not run.

public_facts_summary_controls.scope: Original public factsheet and summary APIs, finite synthetic strings; no complete wrapper or filesystem identity claim

findings: Factsheet punctuation trimming removes both minus and plus from large integers. Inputs delta -1234567 and delta +1234567 yield the same1234567 fact and identical Prose/Structured summaries in the finite authored histories.

Factsheet stops collecting at512 candidates before discarding high-cardinality versions/large integers. A SHA placed after512 versions is omitted even within the256KiB scan window; placing it first retains it. This is a bounded selection trade-off, not exhaustive identifier preservation.

The single-line60014-byte valid JSON-shaped input crosses the default byte summarization trigger, but Prose preserves the entire input as its tail and returns60085 bytes. A line-count output bound is not a byte reduction or peak-memory bound.
This direct summary result does not establish that full wrap emits the expanded text: net-win and other wrapper branches are separate and were not exercised by this control.

Summary extraction joins the full input and dropped prefix and scans distinctive terms across that prefix; factsheet output limits do not by themselves bound all summary allocation. No new allocator or throughput measurement in this turn.
transfer_decision: Do not use bounded text summaries or extracted identifiers as exact file identity. No production source adopted.
limits: 285 focused original tests do not qualify the full repository, all wrapper configurations or universal information preservation.
Finite controls distinguish output shape, selected content, byte size and equality; none is a universal duplicate-search proof.
No rrrah production/test changes this turn. Native pHash.org/ASAN remains skipped.
